LAW AND MOTION 301, ARGUED; DEFENDANT SIGMATECH, INCORPORATED'S MOTION TO DISMISS FOR INCONVENIENT FORUM AND/ OR MOTION TO QUASH SUMMONS FOR LACK OF JURISDICTION OVER DEFENDANT IS DENIED. THE DEFENDANT HAS NOT PRESENTED EVIDENCE TO SHOW THE EXISTENCE AND THE APPLICABILITY OF A FORUM SELECTION CLAUSE BETWEEN THESE PARTIES. THIS IS WITHOUT PREJUDICE FOR THE DEFENDANT TO RENEW THIS MOTION IF IT CAN DO SO IN AN APPROPRIATE TIME. MR. LENDORMY TO PREPARE FORM OF ORDER. JUDGE: PETER J. BUSCH, REPORTER: CAROL KAREN, CSR #8189
